title: E-GRAM SWARAJ AND AUDITONLINE
body_text:
The Ministry of Panchayati Raj is implementing the e-Panchayat Mission Mode Project (MMP) to strengthen digital governance in Panchayati Raj Institutions across the country. Under the project, eGramSwaraj and AuditOnline have been developed to facilitate digital planning, budgeting, accounting, audit, asset management and monitoring of Panchayat activities. Gram Panchayat Development Plans (GPDPs) are prepared through a participatory planning process and uploaded on the eGramSwaraj portal.
Further, eGramSwaraj has been integrated with various Government digital platforms, including the Public Financial Management System (PFMS) for online payments and financial management, Government e-Marketplace (GeM) for procurement, BHASHINI for multilingual AI-enabled services, BSNL for BharatNet connectivity monitoring and the India Meteorological Department (IMD) for weather-related information.
The State/UT-wise details of implementation of eGramSwaraj and AuditOnline, including the State of Madhya Pradesh and the Gwalior Lok Sabha Constituency, are given at Annexure-I .
The Ministry of Panchayati Raj conducts capacity-building programmes for elected representatives, Panchayat Secretaries and other Panchayat functionaries under the Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA). The training programmes include training on digital governance, effective utilisation of the e-Panchayat applications, preparation of Gram Panchayat Development Plans (GPDPs), data management and evidence-based planning.
The State/UT-wise details of participants trained under RGSA, including those relating to the Gwalior Lok Sabha Constituency, are given at Annexure-II . The district/ constituency-wise details are maintained by the respective State Government. The training programmes have contributed to improved adoption and utilisation of the e-Panchayat applications, enhanced digital capacity of Panchayat functionaries and strengthened transparency and efficiency in Panchayat governance.

enrichment.summary: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj informed the Lok Sabha that under the e-Panchayat Mission Mode Project, it has developed eGramSwaraj and AuditOnline portals for digital planning, budgeting, accounting, audit and asset management of Panchayats. eGramSwaraj is integrated with PFMS, GeM, BHASHINI, BSNL/BharatNet and IMD, and as of FY 2025-26 over 2.5 lakh Village Panchayats are onboarded on the PFMS interface with over 2.5 lakh GPDPs uploaded. The Ministry also shared state-wise audit report generation data for FY 2024-25 and RGSA capacity-building training figures for Panchayat functionaries from 2022-23 to 2026-27.
enrichment.context:
The e-Panchayat Mission Mode Project is one of the 44 Mission Mode Projects under India's National e-Governance Plan (NeGP), aimed at bringing transparency, accountability and efficiency to India's roughly 2.5 lakh Gram Panchayats, the foundational tier of local self-government envisaged under the 73rd Constitutional Amendment (1992). eGramSwaraj functions as a single-window platform for Gram Panchayat Development Plan (GPDP) preparation, works and financial tracking, while AuditOnline digitizes social and financial audits of Panchayat accounts, addressing long-standing concerns about weak financial accountability at the grassroots level highlighted by CAG and Finance Commission reports. Integration with PFMS enables direct benefit-like transparency in fund transfers, with GeM enabling transparent procurement, and BHASHINI's AI-based multilingual support aims to bridge language barriers for rural functionaries, reflecting the government's broader Digital India and 'minimum government, maximum governance' push.

The Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA), revamped and extended, is the Centrally Sponsored Scheme providing training and capacity-building to elected Panchayat representatives and functionaries, complementing digital tools with human capacity to strengthen decentralized planning (GPDPs) as mandated under Article 243G's Eleventh Schedule subjects. Such reforms are significant for India's 'cooperative and competitive federalism' architecture, especially as GPDPs increasingly link local planning to national schemes like the SDGs localization agenda and the 'Localisation of SDGs' framework promoted by NITI Aayog and the Ministry of Panchayati Raj.

prelims_questions.question: eGramSwaraj, mentioned frequently in the context of Panchayati Raj digital governance, is integrated with which of the following platforms?
options: PFMS, GeM, BHASHINI, BSNL and IMD
National Informatics Centre Services Inventory (NICSI) only
prelims_questions.explanation: As per the release, eGramSwaraj is integrated with PFMS (payments), GeM (procurement), BHASHINI (multilingual AI services), BSNL (BharatNet connectivity monitoring) and IMD (weather information).

prelims_questions.question: The Gram Panchayat Development Plan (GPDP) is prepared under which constitutional/administrative framework?
options: The Eleventh Schedule functions devolved under Article 243G to Panchayats
The Twelfth Schedule functions devolved to Municipalities
The Ninth Schedule protecting land reform laws
The Sixth Schedule provisions for tribal areas administration
prelims_questions.explanation: GPDPs are prepared for participatory local planning of subjects listed in the Eleventh Schedule, devolved to Panchayats under Article 243G of the Constitution.
